title: U.S. House, District 23
what_it_does: Represents Florida's 23th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives; votes on federal laws and spending.
verified_ballot_note: Roster from WPTV, WLRN and Florida Politics: Lois Frankel (D) vs. Deborah Adeimy (R). The redrawn CD 23 lies entirely within Palm Beach County. No NPA candidate identified; absence unconfirmed. Sources: https://www.wptv.com/news/political/elections-local/lois-frankel-wins-democratic-nomination-for-u-s-house-in-floridas-23rd-congressional-district ; https://floridapolitics.com/archives/814105-lois-frankel-to-face-republican-challenger-deborah-adeimy-for-control-of-new-cd-23-seat/ ; https://www.wlrn.org/government-politics/2026-08-18/lois-frankel-wins-victoria-doyle-florida-23-primary Florida adopted a new congressional map (passed Apr 29, 2026, signed May 4, 2026) that reworked 21 of 28 districts; county descriptions here reflect post-redistricting reporting where found (https://www.wusf.org/politics-issues/2026-05-06/breakdown-changes-for-florida-new-congressional-map).

candidates.name: Lois Frankel
candidates.photo_source: congress.gov member portrait (bioguide ID from memory, unverified)
candidates.residence: West Palm Beach, Palm Beach County
candidates.background: Lois Frankel, a former West Palm Beach mayor and Florida House minority leader, has served in Congress since 2013 and currently represents the 22nd District; after the 2026 map she shifted her candidacy to the new 23rd. She won the Aug. 18, 2026 Democratic primary with about 75%, defeating Victoria Doyle (about 23%) and Mark Piper (about 2%). Note: she is a sitting member of Congress; the current CD 23 representative, Jared Moskowitz, is running in CD 25.
candidates.primary_result: Won Aug 18, 2026 Democratic primary with ~75% over Victoria Doyle (~23%) and Mark Piper (~2%) (WPTV; WLRN)
